descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D6 · P1 · Daniela

转录 / 保留时长和 UAT 3.6 不一致：归档 48 小时（不是 36）、养老院保留 3 次访视（不是 2 次）、「Earlier sessions」和「Most Recent」不带日期、快速口述框永不过期、保留时长写死在代码里（是不是要做成配置）

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-16/S10, TC-16/S11, TC-16/S14, TC-16/S23, TC-16/S27, OAT-04/S19, TC-04/S10

思路 / Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S28 「时间线窗口来自保留配置，不是写死的值」 Timeline windows come from the retention config, not hard-coded values

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U12 Retention windows are configuration values, not hard-coded (so they can be lengthened under a hospital affiliation); the Hospital timeline window follows from them.（UAT 3.6；UAT TC-11）
  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules.（UAT TC-11；UAT 3.6；TFA-92589 AC 4）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Main's code and UAT 3.6 ('All windows are configuration values, not hard-coded'; 'Course timeline … therefore show today and yesterday only')

When Read where the Hospital timeline window comes from (isRecentCourseLine in src/domain/courseTimeline.ts: today's and yesterday's labels) and the Nursing Home visit count (SHOW_LAST = 3 in src/features/snf/patient/panels/CoursePanel.tsx), and compare with the retention config (HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION in conve …

Then Both display windows derive from configured values, so lengthening retention under a hospital affiliation lengthens what the timeline shows

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Doc review by a developer, every finding quoted with file and line. A window that does not read the config is a finding against 3.6; it becomes a Fail or a pass once Q15 says whether the derived display must follow the config

The Hospital timeline's today/yesterday window and the Nursing Home last-3-visits are fixed in the app code. If retention were lengthened for a hospital affiliation, the timeline would still show the same entries.

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S28

Timeline windows come from the retention config, not hard-coded values

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status fail-pending-Q15 → 待人看（只在开放问题 Q15 上失败，还不算失败 → 待人看）。

Detail:

Neither display window reads the retention config. In the Hospital timeline, isRecentCourseLine (apps/web/src/domain/courseTimeline.ts:62-68) keeps a dated line only if its label equals today's or yesterday's date (todayCourseLabel / yesterdayCourseLabel). The two-day window is fixed in client code. In the Nursing Home course panel, CoursePanel.tsx:12 sets its own `const SHOW_LAST = 3`. HOSPITAL_RETENTION and SNF_RETENTION in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts are module-private (`const`, not exported) and are used only by the backend purge. SNF_RETENTION does set transcriptVisits: 3, which happens to match SHOW_LAST, but the panel never reads it. So lengthening retention under a hospital affiliation would change what the purge keeps but not what either timeline shows. This goes against UAT 3.6 ("all windows are configuration values"). The oracle says such a window is a finding that becomes a Fail or a pass only once Q15 decides whether the displayed window must follow the config. Both findings are therefore labelled pending:Q15 and the verdict is pending. No recorded gap applies.

等开放问题（pendingOn）：

  • Q15

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • Q15: must the displayed timeline windows (Hospital today+yesterday; Nursing Home last 3 visits) follow the retention config? Until Q15 is answered, the hard-coded values are pending findings, not a Fail.
  • The question's pass/fail rule would call this a fail outright, but the oracle sends it to Q15, so the verdict here is pending.
  • Q15: must the derived timeline display windows follow the retention config? If yes, both hard-coded windows (isRecentCourseLine today/yesterday, SHOW_LAST = 3) are a Fail; if no, they pass.
  • The retention config has no field for the course timeline. Even if Q15 says the display must follow the config, someone needs to say which value (for example HOSPITAL_RETENTION.previousNote at 36h, or SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits) should set each window.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • Whether UAT 3.6's 'all windows are configuration values' covers the derived display windows as well as the purge windows (this is Q15).
  • Whether UAT 3.6's 'not hard-coded' rule covers the client display windows as well as the server purge windows (Q15).

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：If a hospital affiliation lengthens retention, physicians would still see only today's and yesterday's Hospital timeline lines and only the last 3 Nursing Home visits. The data the purge now keeps longer would not appear in the timeline. / If an affiliation lengthens retention, physicians will still see only today's and yesterday's Hospital timeline lines and only the last 3 Nursing Home visits, even though older data is now kept.

审查结论（verdict）：fail

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
